selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq (STAR + HTSeq-count), liver, perigonadal WAT, quadriceps muscle
selected.primary_estimand: Effect of 20 weeks of voluntary running-wheel exercise in obese Ldlr-/-.Leiden mice with pre-existing NASH that stay on HFD (HFD+running wheel vs HFD control), per organ (liver, eWAT, muscle)
selected.sample_inclusion: all 50-week animals in the GEO series; organs analysed separately
planned_contrasts: H.Hrw vs H.H (exercise vs HFD control), per organ (abstract METHODS/RESULTS: treatment groups compared with untreated control group; paper DEG count not available)
H.Crw vs H.H (combination vs HFD control), per organ (abstract; count not available)
H.C vs H.H (diet change vs HFD control), per organ (abstract; count not available)
selected.repeated_measure_unit: mouse (mousenr) appears in several organs, but organs are analysed separately, so each fit has one sample per mouse
selected.paper_method: DESeq2 per GEO data_processing ('These counts serve as input for the statistical analysis using DEseq2 package'); exact model and threshold not available (abstract only)
selected.paper_results: Abstract: pathway analysis shows exercise and diet change affect complementary metabolic/lipid-handling pathways and share inflammation pathways; no DEG counts or genes given

decisions.reason: No full text available. Study map built from the PubMed abstract (METHODS, RESULTS) and the GEO series summary/overall_design/treatment_protocol. Groups: HFD 30 wk then 20 wk of HFD (control), HFD+running wheel (exercise), chow switch (diet), chow+running wheel (combination); chow reference kept on chow 50 wk. GEO donor.allergen.dose codes: C.C, H.H, H.Hrw, H.C, H.Crw (diet 1-30wk . diet 31-50wk, rw = running wheel). The 30-week reference groups in the paper are not in GEO.

checks: GEO series title equals the paper title
contact A. van den Hoek is the first author
138 matrix columns = 138 GEO samples after key normalisation

decisions.reason: GSE179394 series title and summary are the paper's title and abstract; the merged count file is the series-level supplementary file.

Matrix columns are the GEO titles without the leading 's' (liver/most eWAT) and, for 8 NovaSeq eWAT samples, with a '_R2' suffix; the 'R' suffix (e.g. 103566-001-028R) appears in both. Key derived from title by stripping 's'; matrix columns by stripping '_R2'. Exact match on the derived key, no positional alignment.

selected.paper_input: HTSeq-count read counts, 'not normalised per sample', input to DESeq2 (GEO data_processing)

candidates: raw_counts (confirm against provenance: normalized integers and rounded estimated counts look the same)

decisions.reason: integer fraction 1.0, max 2.4e6, median 0; GEO data_processing: STAR + HTSeq-count 0.6.1p1, raw counts for DESeq2.

Abstract: groups 'treated for 20 weeks with exercise, diet change or the combination' vs 'untreated (control group)'. Exercise effect as the paper intends = HHrw vs HH within each organ; combination vs HH also contains exercise; diet vs HH is kept as a paper contrast for context; HCrw vs HC (exercise on chow background) is exploratory and not stated in the abstract.

covariates.name: platform
covariates.disposition: included in the eWAT model only (NextSeq vs NovaSeq batch; liver all NextSeq, muscle all NovaSeq)

decisions.reason: eWAT samples were sequenced on two platforms (8 NovaSeq samples, all in HCrw and HHrw, re-sequenced '_R2'); HH, HC, CC eWAT are all NextSeq. Platform is partially confounded with exercise in eWAT, so it is included as a covariate in the eWAT fit (estimable within HCrw and HHrw). Liver and muscle are single-platform. Each mouse contributes one sample per organ, so no subject blocking.

selected.method: DESeq2 (pydeseq2 Wald), one model per organ

paper_route.reason: GEO data_processing names DESeq2; exact model unknown (abstract only)

deviations: platform covariate in eWAT is our decision; paper model unknown

decisions.reason: Raw HTSeq counts and GEO data_processing name DESeq2.

selected.deviation_note: Full text unavailable; abstract states no threshold. Workflow default BH padj < 0.05 applied. Audit rule raw p < 0.01 is a labelled comparison only (commonly used by this group's DESeq2 pathway analyses; not verified against this paper).

decisions.reason: one DESeq2 model on all liver samples (5 groups)
one DESeq2 model on all eWAT samples with platform covariate
one DESeq2 model on all muscle samples (5 groups)
eWAT without platform covariate, to show its influence
